$comment: The 29 built-in looks as the UI presents them. id is a stable slug; inputs lists what the look needs to do its job (empty = runs on its own). thumbnail is the motion-portrait motif id used by <LookThumb> (see reference/Looks.html).

categories.name: Ambient
categories.blurb: No input — they run on their own.

categories.name: Tempo
categories.blurb: Land on the beat: internal, Pro DJ Link or the music.

categories.name: Audio
categories.blurb: Follow Music Assistant: loudness, beat, spectrum.

looks.name: Sunset
looks.description: A slow gradient from warm at the floor to deep blue at the ceiling, with the Candles on LIFX Flame.

looks.name: Fireflies
looks.description: Fireflies wander the room; a lamp only glows while one drifts through it.

looks.name: Embers
looks.description: The Candles and the Tube run LIFX Flame while embers rise from the floor and climb the other lamps.

looks.name: Rain storm
looks.description: Rain runs down the lamps, and lightning strikes a random spot, lighting each lamp by distance.

looks.name: Snow
looks.description: Snow drifts down and catches on the lamps as it passes.

looks.name: Aurora
looks.description: Aurora curtains drift near the ceiling; the Candles and the Tube run LIFX Morph in the same palette.

looks.name: Lava
looks.description: A slow 3D plasma in lava colours that never quite repeats.

looks.name: Color carousel
looks.description: Each lamp’s hue comes from its angle around the room, so a rainbow slowly circles you.

looks.name: Ripples
looks.description: Drops land on the floor and send rings outward; lamps shimmer as the rings pass.

looks.name: Focus
looks.description: Calm and warm near the sofa, busier and more colourful further away.

looks.name: Spotlights
looks.description: Two soft spotlights drift from lamp to lamp.

looks.name: Beat bursts
looks.description: Every beat fires particles out of the TV, with a bigger burst on the downbeat.

looks.name: Shockwave + beam
looks.description: A sphere of light expands from the TV every beat while a lighthouse beam turns once per bar.

looks.name: Vortex
looks.description: Particles spiral up around the room, kicked faster on each beat.

looks.name: Twin comets
looks.description: Two comets chase lamp to lamp, landing on each beat.

looks.name: Fountain
looks.description: A fountain on the coffee table sprays particles, with a bigger burst on every beat.

looks.name: Flock
looks.description: A flock swirls as one and scatters on every other downbeat.

looks.name: Bouncing ball
looks.description: One ball ricochets around the room and lands exactly on every beat.

looks.name: Scanner
looks.description: A horizontal plane sweeps floor to ceiling and back every two beats.

looks.name: 3D checker
looks.description: 1 m cubes swap colours on each beat, like a disco floor in 3D.

looks.name: Speaker waves
looks.description: Kicks send wavefronts out from the speakers, snares bloom between them, hi-hats sparkle up high.

looks.name: Room spectrum
looks.description: Height is frequency; bass lights the floor, treble the ceiling.

looks.name: Tide
looks.description: A water line rises and falls with loudness, with foam at the surface.

looks.name: Drop moment
looks.description: A calm verse, a build where a plane rises and the strobe doubles each bar, then a white flash and shockwaves on the drop.

looks.name: Home sunset
looks.description: The sunset in every room, with a warm sun that follows the real one across the apartment.

looks.name: Wisp
looks.description: Two wisps roam room to room; each lamp glows only while one passes.

looks.name: Goodnight
looks.description: A warm glow walks through the home switching rooms off behind it, and leaves the bedroom on a night light.

looks.name: Doorbell ripple
looks.description: The doorbell sends a golden ring from the front door through every room, over whatever is running.

looks.name: Firmware showcase
looks.description: Every light runs its own built-in effect. Lights without one, like the Govee lamp, get a streamed copy.
